title: Zotero Attachment Missing File Watch
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=research:paper collection=* attachment_present=*
| stats sum(eval(if(attachment_present="no",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by collection
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending missing attachments backlog by collection for Zotero library hygiene.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside Zotero library hygiene.
implementation: Mark each `research:paper` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `collection`.
visualization: Table of collection with pending missing attachments counts.
grandmaExplanation: It lists where unfinished missing attachments are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in Zotero library hygiene.
